scripts.gates:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy && uv run lint-imports && uv run pytest -q
scripts.gates:admin: pnpm -C apps/admin lint && pnpm -C apps/admin type-check && pnpm -C apps/admin format:check && pnpm -C apps/admin test
scripts.gates:client: pnpm -C apps/client lint && pnpm -C apps/client type-check && pnpm -C apps/client format:check && pnpm -C apps/client test
scripts.gates: pnpm gates:api && pnpm gates:admin && pnpm gates:client
